render_volume: render a volumetric primitive scene using Mitsuba with a PLY volume file and output an EXR image
configure_scene_load_dict: configure a Mitsuba scene dictionary with volprim_prb integrator, ellipsoidsmesh primitives, and perspective camera
scale_sigmat_params: scale the sigma_t parameter of volumetric primitives for adjusting volume density
render_with_benchmark: render a Mitsuba scene with specified samples per pixel inside a volprim benchmark context
write_rendered_bitmap: write a rendered Mitsuba image to an EXR file on disk using mi.util.write_bitmap
